The '''MC80 ''Liberty'' Type Heavy Star Cruiser''' or '''MC80 ''Liberty'' type Star Cruiser''' was an early type of [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] put into service for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Mon Calamari Star Cruisers in the Databank">{{DB|starship|moncalamaristarcruiser|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser}}</ref>

==Characteristics==
===Dimensions===
[[File:MC80_egvv.jpg|thumb|left|200px|''Liberty'' [[:Category:Technical drawing images|schematics]]]]
Like most [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] designs, each vessel was individually unique, which was frustrating for Rebel technicians. As with other Calamari designs during the [[The galaxy/Legends|Galactic]] Civil War, all [[Warship/Legends|warships]] in this group were standardized as much as possible to aid non-Calamari crewmembers, something the artistic Mon Calamari accepted begrudgingly.<ref name="RASB" />

A common variant of the [[MC80 Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 Star Cruiser]] line was exemplified by the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] [[Liberty/Legends|''Liberty'']]. It had an array of nine engines, divided into three different sizes, located at the stern. A large wing-shaped superstructure was affixed to the main hull on either side, containing weapons pods and [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] arrays.<ref name="TEGTVAV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref> [[MC80a Star Cruiser|Some MC80 cruisers]] had their wing sections shortened and were equipped with an additional thruster.<ref name="ROTJ" />

===Offensive and defensive systems===
Blisters filled with [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] cannons, [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] projectors, tractor beam projectors and Ion Cannons were scattered throughout each vessel, many of which were located on the wing structures.<ref name="TEGTVAV" /> The Turbolasers and the Ion cannons possessed advanced targeting systems and were able to track and destroy fighters and smaller craft.

[[File:MC80_Liberty-type_Cruiser_TFM.png|thumb|left|200px|An MC80 ''Liberty'' type Cruiser engages Imperial Star Destroyers in battle.]]
While their armaments, which varied from ship to ship, were less than those found on the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] mile-long [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]], their shielding capability was far more advanced. The multiple backup shields and multiple shield generators ensured that a Calamarian cruiser could not only last in combat against more heavily armed opponents but also they had more protection from spacial elemental threats.<ref name="Star Wars Sourcebook">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref>

On ''Liberty'' type cruisers, the primary [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor array]] was located on the ventral side of the ship. On ships that did not have the wing shaped structures, an additional thruster replaced the [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] array.<ref name="ROTJ" />

===Hangar complement===
The standard fighter complement on a MC80 was three [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]]. The typical makeup of a three squadron wing on a MC80 included one [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]], one [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]], and one [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing]] squadron. At the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], it is possible that the MC80 Cruiser [[Home One/Legends|''Home One'']] also carried a squadron of [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing starfighters]].

===Bridge===
[[File:LibertyTypeEngines-SWE.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The back of engines on a ''Liberty'' type cruiser]]
The bridge tower of an MC80 was located towards the stern of the vessel, slightly sunken into the main hull, unlike on Imperial Star Destroyers. The ship's main reactor was found right behind the bridge section.<ref name="TEGTVAV" />

The vessels were crewed by various species of Rebel personnel, though the command crew was exclusively Mon Calamari, due to the nature of the bridge display screens being designed for the Mon Calamari viewing spectrum.<ref name="RASB" />

==History==
The origins of the design went back to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], when blueprints for a Mon Calamari-designed capital ship were stolen by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]]. The vessel depicted appeared identical to the MC80 ''Liberty'' type, thus giving the subclass a military origin.<ref name="RHNCE15:01:03">{{InsiderCite|72|Republic HoloNet News Core Edition 15:01:03}}</ref>

===Rebel service===
[[File:Liberty-SWM.png|thumb|left|250px|The ''Liberty'' departs after leaving a Star Destroyer severely damaged in battle.]]
This class was composed of the initial group of [[Passenger liner/Legends|starliners]] modified for combat duty by Mon Calamari and Rebel techs. The cruisers represented the first line of large [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] deployed by the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="Mon Calamari Star Cruisers in the Databank" />

The entry of the Mon Calamari into the Alliance ensured that the undergunned and outnumbered [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Rebel fleet]] would possess the firepower to deal with [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]], and when grouped, even heavier combatants. This was shown during the climactic [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], when a [[Flotilla/Legends|flotilla]] of Mon Calamari ships attacked the massive [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] and brought down its shields.<ref name="ROTJ" /><ref name="Mon Calamari Star Cruisers in the Databank" />

===Later military service===
At the [[Battle of Mindor]], the twin of the [[Liberty/Legends|''Liberty'']], known as the [[Justice (MC80 Star Cruiser)|''Justice'']], was used by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to fight against [[Cronal|Lord Shadowspawn's]] forces in the [[Taspan system]]. The cruiser stayed in frontline service for several years in the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] fleet, eventually getting outclassed by the [[MC80B Star Cruiser|MC80B]],<ref name="TEGTVAV" /> [[MC90 Star Cruiser|MC90]],<ref name="Dark Empire Sourcebook">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> [[Mediator-class battle cruiser|''Mediator'']], and [[Viscount-class Star Defender|''Viscount'']] designs.<ref name="Vector Prime">''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]''</ref> Many were reconverted back into starliners, medical ships, evacuation cruisers, etc. During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], many of the remaining ships were pushed back into service but were quickly outclassed by the enemy ships.

By [[137 ABY]], the criminal organization [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] had at least one MC80 in service, stationed near sector [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] [[Lun Rask]]'s [[Tibanna gas platform|headquarters]] over [[Kaer]]. The [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] also utilized the aging warships, with one being destroyed by [[1st Imperial Center Core Defense Squadron|Skull Squadron]] as it attempted to find the main Remnant fleet.<ref name="SWL37" /> Several were used during the [[Evacuation of Dac]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:LibertysBackside-XWARender.jpg|thumb|right|''Liberty'' as depicted in ''Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance'']]
In the game ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]'', ''Liberty'' is noted as being 1,500 meters long and is presented in-game with a different thruster array. The model used for the cut-scenes however, does portray a similar thruster array to the ILM studio model.
